The n=4 sector provides exactly two independent slots — matching the two remaining knot-mediated forces (strong T_{2,9}, weak T_{3,5}); their forced Gram structure [[d^2,d],[d,d^2]] splits into symmetric/antisymmetric channels with eigenvalues d(d+/-1).
